title: Jazz Got My Feet Back
style: Modern phonk funk track, heavy rolling 808 bass, chopped and screwed vintage jazz and funk samples, groovy electric bassline, funky rhythm guitar stabs, crisp bouncy drums with swing. Upbeat, energetic, danceable modern funk mixed with phonk swagger and playful jazz energy. Male vocalist Chas delivers cool, hype, storytelling verses with attitude and bounce. Female vocalist Jazz performs virtuosic, fun, improvisational jazz scat throughout — especially on “bee boo bop”, “scat scat cat”, “doo bee doo bah” — layered and playful. Theme is a sleek female jazz singer named Jazz with panthera cat energy, fast scat feet, and the power to bring the beat back. Sneaky beat, modern funk groove, catchy explosive chorus. High production, fun, funky, slightly mysterious cat vibe. 142 BPM, F minor with bright funky lifts in the chorus. Strong phonk bass presence under the scat sections.
lyrics:
[Intro – Jazz Scat + light phonk bounce]
Scat scat cat… bee boo bop…
Panthera on the prowl… fast feet, don’t stop…
Scat scat cat… bee boo bop…
[Verse 1 – Chas]
Chas singing to Jazz, yeah she got that jazz
Singer named Jazz with the modern phonk funk swag
She got the speak, right off the beak, never weak
Improvising on the fly, make the whole room freak
Sneaky beat creeping, phonk in the trunk
Funk in the bass, got the floor bumping
Snap back — wait, forgot that — but she brings it back
Back back back, put the whole groove on track
Oh yeah… I am on track now
Jazz got my feet back, how?
[Chorus – Chas + Jazz Scat ad-libs]
Jazz got my feet back! Oh yeah!
Jazz bee boo bop, scat scat cat
Jazz songs dot com, jazz online
Jazz on time, a jazz song all night long
Modern funk, phonk funk, feeling strong
Panthera cat with the fast scat feet
Sneaky beat bringing all the heat
Jazz bee boo bop… bring it back back back!
[Verse 2 – Chas]
Phonk funk fusion, modern twist on the classic
Jazz on the mic, making it look so graphic
Fast feet moving like a cat on the hunt
Panthera energy, never in a slump
She got the speak that cuts right through the noise
Right off the beak with that jazzy poise
Chas in the cut, singing straight to Jazz
“Hold it down baby, you the one with the jazz”
Snap back to the beat, never miss a step
Forgot the words but the groove still kept
Brings it back stronger every single time
Jazz online, dropping dimes all night
[Bridge – Jazz Scat breakdown + Chas hype]
Jazz: Bee boo bop… doo bee doo bah…
Scat scat cat… yeah yeah yeah…
Chas: Oh yeah, I am on track!
Jazz got my feet back!
Jazz: Bop bop… scat… panthera cat…
Chas: Bring it back back back!
[Final Chorus – Full energy, bigger phonk drop]
Jazz got my feet back! Oh yeah!
Jazz bee boo bop, scat scat cat
Jazz songs dot com, jazz on time
Jazz online, a jazz song all night long
Modern funk, phonk funk, all night long
Panthera cat, fast scat feet
Sneaky beat, can’t be beat
Jazz bee boo bop…
Scat scat cat…
Jazz… Jazz… Jazz got my feet back!
[Outro – Fading Jazz Scat + phonk tail]
Scat scat cat… bee boo bop…
Jazz on time… jazz online…
All night long… modern funk…
Yeah…
